title: Assembly line — Ford (1913)
problem_statement: Craft production could not meet mass demand at affordable prices. The problem is documented and scoped before any solution work begins.
concept: Invention dossier: Ford's 1913 moving assembly line, inspired by meatpacking disassembly lines, brought the work to the worker. Model T assembly time fell from hours to about 90 minutes.
novelty_assessment: Cross-domain transfer: slaughterhouse logic reversed into manufacturing.
validation_plan: Document the outcome honestly whether it confirms or kills the concept.
